answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by making trust glacier-slow to earn and quartz-hard to fake: a new identity starts with no spending power and must accumulate verified work over weeks, with each milestone attested by a different established peer. Endorsements are rate-limited to one per month per endorser, so a single operator cannot mint a dune of fake identities overnight; manufacturing a thousand Sybils would take a thousand months of endorsement capacity. Misbehavior burns the whole accumulated record, not just one account.
